---
title: "HMM POS Tagger for English"
date: 2019-12-01
categories: [nlp, probabilistic modeling]
description: "A hidden Markov model part-of-speech tagger trained on English text."
image: ../images/hmm.png
---

This project implemented a Hidden Markov Model for part-of-speech tagging. The model estimates emission probabilities for words given tags and transition probabilities between tags, then infers likely tag sequences for sentences.

[Code](https://github.com/pratik-ingle/HMM-tagger) · [Write-up](../posts/tutorials/hmm-pos-tagger/index.qmd)
